title: Quality Engine Configuration
description: Project-level configuration schema for Vibe Coding OS quality engine — controls which gates run, their overrides, model profile, task context, and profile structure definitions

enabled_gates.description: Array of gate IDs to explicitly enable. If empty, defaults to all gates in the manifest

disabled_gates.description: Array of gate IDs to explicitly skip during validation runs

gate_overrides.description: Per-gate override settings keyed by gate ID

timeout.description: Override timeout in seconds for this specific gate

level.description: Override severity level for this specific gate

auto_fix.description: Override auto-fix setting for this specific gate

model_profile.description: Determines which advisory gates run based on available compute/capability. 'lean' skips heavy advisory gates, 'standard' runs typical checks, 'heavy' runs all gates including expensive analysis

task_profile.description: Describes the type of work being done, influencing which gates are most relevant. 'any' is the default that runs all appropriate gates

telemetry_enabled.description: Whether to emit telemetry events for gate execution results

output_dir.description: Directory path for storing gate execution reports and artifacts, relative to project root

total_timeout_ms.description: Total maximum execution time in milliseconds for the entire quality engine run

profiles.description: Optional per-profile gate definitions and settings. Overrides the engine built-in defaults when present

lean.description: Fast profile for small, low-risk changes. Runs most relevant gates only for quick signal

gates.description: Gate IDs to run in lean profile

minGates.description: Minimum number of gates that must be selected

advisory.description: Gate IDs that are treated as advisory (non-blocking) in this profile

required_categories.description: Quality categories that must have at least one gate in this profile

standard.description: Default profile for normal implementation work. Balances coverage, speed, and evidence quality

heavy.description: Deepest profile for high-risk changes: auth, data migrations, security, public APIs, release branches, broad refactors

model_id.description: Identifier for the AI model being used (e.g., 'gpt-4o', 'llama-3-8b'). Used for model-aware gate selection

model_capability.description: Computed or declared capability tier of the model: low, medium, or high. Influences gate depth selection

model_profiles_path.description: Path to a JSON file defining model capability profiles, relative to project root

task_risk_classifier_path.description: Path to a JSON file defining task risk classification keywords and profiles

stack_profile_matrix_path.description: Path to a JSON file defining per-profile gate stacks and requirements
